purpose: One status-word family across the browser and the host. Every case is a terminal-or-not task record read by log_events.js (taskDoneIsTerminal + taskTerminalPhase + taskPresentation) and by ouroboros.project_dialogue (outcome_phase + OUTCOME_PHASE_HEADLINE + _completion_verdict). A new axis, reason or acceptance status is added to both sides in the same commit, with a row here.

cases.name: completed while post-task synthesis is still open reads Working on both sides
cases.headline: Working

cases.name: legacy task_done frame carrying status done stays terminal
cases.headline: Done

cases.name: cancelled outranks failure-shaped teardown side facts
cases.headline: Cancelled

cases.name: owner-requested finalization is a success, not a warning
cases.headline: Done

cases.name: scheduler duplicate rejection is a warning
cases.headline: Done with warnings

cases.name: degraded review with an unaccepted acceptance decision

acceptance_decision.rationale: Acceptance reviewers did not reach a valid quorum.

cases.headline: Done with warnings
cases.acceptance_clause: Acceptance: finalized_unaccepted — Acceptance reviewers did not reach a valid quorum.

cases.name: an accepted decision leaves the execution reason standing
cases.headline: Done

cases.name: a revision request without a rationale states the status alone
cases.headline: Done with warnings

cases.name: a hard failure explains itself by its execution reason, not by the decision
cases.headline: Failed

cases.name: an objective warning is a warning even when every status word is clean
cases.headline: Done with warnings
